out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Cases of plastic cups and cup lids were stored on the floor in the back storage room.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Please move the cases of cups and cup lids off the floor as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poisonous or Toxic Material
violations.observation: A container previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials (all purpose floor cleaner) is being used to store concentrated quaternary ammonium sanitizer. Sanitizer was stored in old floor cleaner pump bottle for ease of dispensing into sink, as facility does not have a sink mounted dispensing system.
violations.corrective_action: Do not store food in containers previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials. This practice may result in food contamination and subsequent medical consequences to anyone consuming the contaminated food. Floor cleaner bottle containing sanitizer concentrate was discarded along with remaining sanitizer. PIC located new bottle of sanitizer concentrate, and this was placed by the 3 vat sink to use for the sanitizer compartment.

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonium solution was measured at above 500 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food- contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quaternary ammonium solution at 200-400ppm per the product label. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. Solution was discarded.
